requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL provide a real-LLM end-to-end verification harness that initializes a clean workspace, enables both modeling and engineering registries, creates a track with both delta types, implements the track, and records code quality evidence.

case.given: A clean temporary workspace initialized with codument
case.when: The E2E harness enables modeling and engineering and asks a real agent to plan a business application track
case.then: The generated track SHALL contain `modeling_deltas/**/*.xnl` and `engineering_deltas/**/*.xnl`
case.and: The harness SHALL run `codument validate`, `codument modeling validate --deltas`, and `codument engineering validate --deltas`

case.given: The generated track and deltas pass validation
case.when: The E2E harness runs in full mode
case.then: The real agent SHALL implement the application code using the track design and registry deltas as input
case.and: The harness SHALL produce machine-readable and human-readable code quality reports

case.given: The harness is invoked with a built-in topic
case.then: The harness SHALL use the corresponding business prompt and preserve logs for review

requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL install reusable agent skills for running the modeling+engineering E2E harness and for scoring generated code quality.

case.given: codument skill templates are installed or upgraded
case.when: An agent needs to run the real modeling+engineering E2E suite
case.then: The `codument-modeling-engineering-e2e` skill SHALL explain setup, commands, environment variables, outputs, and failure triage

case.given: An agent needs to evaluate generated code quality after an E2E run or track implementation
case.then: The skill SHALL guide evidence-based scoring across runnable behavior, tests, architecture, codument alignment, maintainability, and safety
